problemStatement: Weekly Radar boundaries are locally testable but have no runtime that collects the approved free evidence stack, assembles a report, publishes it to Telegram, or retains bounded longitudinal history.

preReviewWarnings: Verify every normalized fact retains source URI, passage or structured field, effective date, retrieval time, and status/confidence.

acceptance: org-x weekly-radar reads a versioned CompanySourceRegistry and produces deterministic Markdown, Telegram chunks, snapshots, source coverage, and a publication Receipt.
P0/P1/P2 adapters cover SEC EDGAR/XBRL, configured company official pages, Greenhouse, Lever, and GDELT discovery without paid APIs or LLM extraction.
Every normalized fact retains provenance; ambiguous rule extraction returns UNKNOWN.
Telegram reads ORGX_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and ORGX_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID only from runtime environment/Secrets, redacts them, and preserves ordered chunk/retry semantics.
The workflow uses cron 0 0 * * 1, workflow_dispatch, actions/checkout@v5, ORGX_SEC_USER_AGENT, Telegram Secrets, concurrency protection, and contents:write only for data.
Each run removes files older than 365 days on data and compacts only data history; main and other branches are untouched.
Fixture-driven unit, integration, architecture, workflow, dry-run, and failure tests pass without external HTTP or Telegram delivery.
The complete AI Cockpit lifecycle finishes: Contract, preflight, implementation, Summary, strict Finish, archive, push, PR, CI, merge, close, and cleanup.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.
Keep provider-specific acquisition and parsing outside Domain.
Use deterministic fixtures and injected transports; no secrets or external network calls in tests.
Treat missing data as UNKNOWN or UNAVAILABLE and never infer from absence.
Keep defects inside this runtime scope in WI-WR-016 unless materially outside the Contract.
Use actions/checkout@v5 and do not reintroduce checkout@v4.

intent.problem: The Weekly Radar feature boundaries are provider-neutral contracts without a runtime for the approved free evidence stack, report generation, Telegram publication, or bounded history.
constraints: Official primary evidence first, free public interfaces second, GDELT/web only for discovery or configured official material.
No paid API dependency and no LLM extraction; ambiguous rules produce UNKNOWN.
Preserve provenance and keep providers outside Domain.
Run Monday 09:00 JST via Actions with manual dispatch and checkout@v5.
Persist on dedicated data, retain one year, and restrict compaction to data.
Complete the full AI Cockpit lifecycle under human-approved execution.
intent.rationale: A free evidence-first runtime matches ORG-X's long research horizon and builds auditable Evidence History without buying a universal API or allowing inference to outrun source quality.
